notes: One physical period, many naming systems: every token is a distinct slot with a shared periodId.
Overlapping tokens (e.g. A1 and M1 on MON 8:00) are intentional; never deduplicate by time.
S8 (11:40) and S8B (12:35) on SAT, S10/S10B on SUN are separate real slots.
L18/L24 retain the new 12:35-1:25 config times; dayTimeOverrides records divergence from campus.
Law tokens (A, TAA, TEE, ...) are first-class slots in the law programme, resolving to the same periods as core tokens; core slots keep the aliases for legacy decode.
